title_patterns_that_work: Use urgent verification framing like 'I Checked If [Brand] Is A Scam... (The Truth)'
Target high-interest consumer apps and financial platforms with '#Shorts'
Include unexpected data points or payout numbers in titles to drive curiosity
title_patterns_to_avoid: Generic long-form titles without clear value propositions or strong hooks
Vague brand explorations without immediate consumer protection angles
Titles lacking the '#Shorts' tag given the massive disparity in short-form view velocity
notes: Short-form content heavily outperforms long-form videos in initial view velocity, particularly when focusing on money-making apps, payout verifications, and scam investigations (e.g., Cashify, KashKick, and Rocket Money).
